title: Precession Explorer
vysu:
# title   : Precession Explorer  
# version : 1
# featured: true
# group   : Precession
# tags    : intro, precession, seasonal-frame
# order   : 10
# Visualize axial precession and seasonal naks against the fixed nakshatra sky

seq 1000   # main sequence start


at 0 {
    # blank stage at -4000 BCE
    stage blank year -4000
    show overlay

    camera pos -86.895,77.787,262.026 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900
    grid equatorial 10   # show equatorial grid

    style nsAxis color yellow
    show nsAxis   # show north-south axis

    camera pos -16.157,280.502,57.591 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900

    style precessionCircle color yellow
    show precessionCircle   # show precession circle path

    seq 2000
    show sisumara
    show thuban
    show matsya
    show polaris
    show NP   # show pole markers

    travel -4000 to -2800 3000: step 100
    #camera pos -10.64,184.717,37.925 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900
     camera pos -0.306,262.855,1.306 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900
      label tNp "2800 BCE - Abhaya Dhruva/Thuban is North Pole" color gold size 1.3
     style thuban lbl(10 gold 50%) 
     flash thuban
     style thuban lbl(5 gold 100%) 
}


+3000 {
    # transition to Polaris era
    clear label tNp

    camera pos -16.157,280.502,57.591 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900
    travel -2800 to 2100 6000: step 100
    wait 4000
    camera pos -0.306,262.855,1.306 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900
    label pNp "2100 CE - Matsya Dhruva/Polaris is North Pole" color gold size 1.3
     style polaris lbl(10 gold 50%) 
     flash polaris
     style polaris lbl(5 gold 100%) 
}


+4000 {
    # clear Polaris label and adjust camera
    clear label pNp
    camera pos -167.086,194.865,143.526 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900
}


+1000 {
    # show nakshatra and ecliptic labels
    camera pos -34.897,173.674,234.754 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900

    show *nak
    show $nak
    show @naks

    #show nakshatralabels 
    flash nakshatralabels

    show eclipticSegments
    flash eclipticLabels

    flash equator
    show equator

    flash NP
    show NP 

    show equatorialPlane 
    stage year -4000
    camera pos 6.327,47.448,290.17 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900
}


+2000 {
    # flash seasonal markers again
    flash VE, SS, AE, WS
    show VE, SS, AE, WS
}

+2000 {
    # repeat initial setup for emphasis
    camera pos -0.131,293.589,0.405 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900

    hide equator 
    hide equatorialPlane
    flash eclipticLabels

     style naks lbl(30%)
     style eclipticSegments lbl(8 70%)
     style AE, SS, WS, VE  lbl(14 100%)
     flash VE, SS, AE, WS
}

+2000 {
    travel -4000 to -2800 3000: step 100
    # camera pos -10.64,184.717,37.925 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900
    label  lblx "2800 BCE - Abhaya Dhruva/Thuban is North Pole" color gold size 1.3
    flash thuban
}

+2000 {
     label clear lblx
    travel -2800 to -1800 2000: step 100
    label lblx "1800 BCE - Maghadi Era - Magha and SS" color gold size 1.3
#    flash @magha 1000:
    flash @mag , sector.mag 1000:
    flash SS 1000:
}

+4000 {
     label clear lblx
    travel -1800 to 2100 4000: step 100
     wait 2000
    # camera pos -10.64,184.717,37.925 target 0,0,0 fov 45 over 900
    label lblx "2100 CE - Matsya Dhruva/Polaris  is North Pole" color gold size 1.3
    flash polaris
}

pNp.text: 2100 CE - Matsya Dhruva/Polaris is North Pole

lblx.text: 2800 BCE - Abhaya Dhruva/Thuban is North Pole
1800 BCE - Maghadi Era - Magha and SS
2100 CE - Matsya Dhruva/Polaris  is North Pole
